plain.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef} everything that's been eating at me. {OTHER_nameDef} just listened, and that was enough.
Bad day. Sat with {OTHER_nameDef} after supper and talked until it was smaller.
[night] Couldn't sleep, so I found {OTHER_nameDef} still up and talked it all out. I feel lighter.
[grieving] I said the name out loud to {OTHER_nameDef} tonight, for the first time since the burial.
[afterraid] Still shaking from the raid. {OTHER_nameDef} let me talk about it without telling me I was lucky.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is a good friend. I unloaded all of it tonight and got only kindness back.

blunt.li: Complained to {OTHER_nameDef} for an hour. Helped more than I'd like to admit.

gloomy.li: Poured it all out to {OTHER_nameDef}. Nothing's changed, but I'm not carrying it alone now.

cold.li: Talking to {OTHER_nameDef} cleared my head. I'll remember that it works.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is my best friend. I don't remember when it happened, only that it has.
If anything happens to me, {OTHER_nameDef} knows where I keep my things and what to do with them. That's what a best friend is.
[winter] Long winter evenings with {OTHER_nameDef}. I've never had a friend like this.
[old] At my age I didn't expect to make a best friend. {OTHER_nameDef} didn't ask my permission.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are as close as family now. Closer than some of my family ever was.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s my best friend. Anyone who has a problem with that can take it up with both of us.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I finish each other's sentences now! It drives the others mad.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the best friend I've ever had. Out here, that's one more thing to lose.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the one person here I trust without reservation. I didn't plan that.

plain.li: [trait:VTE_Academian] I've read everything we own twice, and it's all stacked on the floor. Could we build {THING}?
[trait:VTE_Academian] I can recite most of our books by now. I need something new to read.
[trait:VTE_Snob] I can't be seen in this. Nobody of any standing would be.
[trait:VTE_Tycoon] Silver in the strongbox means a better price from every trader. Ours is nearly empty.
[fighter] My forms are slipping between raids. I need something to practice them on.
[trait:VTE_MartialArtist] I've been practicing my holds on the doorframe. Could we build {THING}?
[fighter] A fighter should know where the weapons are without thinking. Right now I'd have to think.
[trait:VTE_Wanderlust] I've never stayed this long anywhere. Put me on the next caravan, wherever it goes.
[meme:VME_Nomad] Our people were never meant to stay put this long. Let me go out with the next caravan.
[trait:Priest|trait:Paladin|trait:TM_Brightmage] I pray every morning and every night. I'd like a better place for it than behind the storeroom.
[gourmet] I can taste every shortcut the cook takes. Something finer now and then, please.
[neat] I've cleaned my corner three times today, and the mess keeps creeping back in from everywhere else.
[animallover] I'm better company with an animal around. Let me try taming that {SUBJECT}.
[trait:VTE_Workaholic] I'd have worked the extra hours anyway. Now I don't have to hide it.
[trait:VTE_Submissive] Good. Tell me what needs doing and I'll do it.
[meme:VME_HardcoreIndustrialism] A full day's work, every day. That's what we're here for.
[trait:VTE_Rebel] Nobody tells me how long my day is.
[trait:VTE_FunLoving|trait:VTE_Lush] I've been waiting all season for an excuse.
[meme:VME_PartyLife] Music tonight, and tomorrow, and the night after.
[trait:TM_Bard] Three nights of music, and I know exactly what I'm playing first.
[trait:VTE_Workaholic] Days of nothing to do. I'll go mad.
[trait:VTE_Anxious] All those people in one room, every night. I'll be in my room.
[fighter] Good. My forms get sloppy between raids.
[trait:VTE_Brave] We'll be ready this time.
[meme:VME_Bushido] Training is how we honor the fight before it comes.
[trait:VTE_Coward] I'd rather not practice for something I'm hoping never happens.
[meme:VME_Pacifist] I won't learn to hurt people faster.
[mage] Evenings for study. My books have been gathering dust.
[trait:VTE_Academian] Finally, time to read properly.
[trait:VTE_Dunce] The words swim when I look at them too long.
[meme:AM_Monastic] We need far less than we think we do.
[trait:VTE_Snob] We already live like peasants.
[trait:VTE_Snob] About time this colony learned some manners.
[trait:VTE_Rebel] I'll be polite when I feel like it.
[trait:VTE_Groundbreaker] Every hand on the walls. I'll show you how to lay them straight.
[meme:VME_CityBuilders] Walls first, then streets. This place will look like a town by spring.
[trait:VTE_Neat] I've been waiting for this since the day I got here.
[trait:VTE_Slob] It was fine the way it was.
[gourmet] Smaller portions of food that was barely worth eating whole.
